# B494 row (e): engine footprint, cold start, binary size
confined: no (host process, as the row allows). host: Mac14,2 Apple M2, 8 GiB RAM, macOS 27.0.1 (26A434); go version go1.27.2 darwin/arm64
binary: wasmtime-go v49.0.0 static libwasmtime.a (Cranelift, default Config), Go cgo build
sampler: proc_pid_rusage(getpid(), RUSAGE_INFO_V4) in-process, ri_phys_footprint + ri_lifetime_max_phys_footprint;
  series interval 10 ms plus one sample at every phase boundary ('<phase>-enter' rows); a 200 ms idle baseline precedes 'engine'.
load: other gates were running on this laptop at the time (a 'go test ./...' was live), so the timings are an upper bound.

## numbers for R1/R8
compile+load peak: 6.4 MB (tiny module) .. 31.9 MB (177 KB module); steady state equals the peak (no shrink after compile): 6.5 MB / 32.0 MB.
A real component (a few MB of wasm) will sit well above the synthetic one; overhead.podFixed must be set from the module size class,
and 64Mi is NOT a safe floor for a large module.
